sentinelValues.meaning: Scan from the beginning of the index.
Scan from the end of the index.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: SCAN INDEX returns a selection of number records from the table containing the aField field, scanning the index from the beginning (default, or explicit >) or from the end (<).
overloadMerges.note: Added sentinelValues documenting the meaning of the > and < literal-symbol order values; no direction/structure change otherwise.
